items.question: What materials do you work with?
items.answer: We work with steel, stainless steel, aluminum, copper, and other metals. Our laser cutting machines can handle various thicknesses from thin sheets to heavy plates.

items.question: Do you provide design services?
items.answer: Yes! Our team can help you from concept to finished product. We provide design, engineering, and fabrication services.

items.question: What is your turnaround time?
items.answer: Turnaround depends on project complexity. Simple laser cutting can be completed in 1-2 days. Custom fabrication projects typically take 1-2 weeks.

items.question: Do you offer installation services?
items.answer: Yes, we provide complete installation services for all fabricated products, from small components to large structural steel installations.

items.question: How do I get a quote?
items.answer: Contact us with your project details, drawings, or requirements. We'll provide a detailed quote within 24-48 hours.

items.question: What is your minimum order?
items.answer: We handle both small custom jobs and large production runs. No minimum quantity for laser cutting services.

items.question: Do you offer volume discounts?
items.answer: Yes, we offer competitive pricing for larger quantities and ongoing projects. Contact us for volume pricing.
